tool_schemas.name: think
tool_schemas.description: Appends a new thought entry to the current authenticated session’s thought log and returns the created entry (including its sequence and timestamps). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `thought` is not a string or exceeds server limits, and UNAUTHORIZED if no session/auth context is available. Raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the session or account has reached configured limits for thought writes/storage.

tool_schemas.name: get_thoughts
tool_schemas.description: Lists thought entries for the current session filtered by `status` (active or purged), sorted by `sort` and `order`, and returns a page of results limited by `limit` along with an opaque `cursor` for the next page (omit/empty cursor returns the first page; absence of a next cursor means end of list). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid cursor, out-of-range `limit`, or unsupported sort/order combinations, and UNAUTHORIZED if no session/auth context is available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced session does not exist for the caller.

limit.description: Maximum number of thoughts to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: clear_thoughts
tool_schemas.description: Clears the current session’s thought log by purging (soft-deleting) all active thoughts when `purge` is true, and records the optional `reason` as a session event; returns a summary of what was cleared. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `purge` is not a boolean or `reason` is invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if no session/auth context is available. Raises CONFLICT if the session is not in a state that allows purging (for example, already finalized/locked), and NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist for the caller.

purge.description: If true, soft-delete (purge) all thoughts in the current session.

reason.description: Optional reason for clearing thoughts (stored in the session event payload).

tool_schemas.name: get_thought_stats
tool_schemas.description: Returns aggregate statistics for thoughts in the current session (counts and related totals), optionally including purged entries when `include_purged` is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `include_purged` is not a boolean, and UNAUTHORIZED if no session/auth context is available. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced session does not exist for the caller.

include_purged.description: If true, include purged thoughts in the statistics.

tool_schemas.name: get_session
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current authenticated session record resolved from the caller’s auth context (and optional external session key), including status, counters, and timestamps. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no valid API key/session context is present, and NOT_FOUND if the resolved session does not exist.

external_session_key.description: Optional external session identifier to select (or create) a distinct session under the caller’s API key.

create_if_missing.description: If true, creates an active session when no session exists for the given external_session_key (or implicit session when none is provided). If false, returns NOT_FOUND when missing.

tool_schemas.name: close_session
tool_schemas.description: Transitions the current session to status='closed' and records a session_closed event. After closing, further writes (think/clear) are refused for that session. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no session/auth context is available, and CONFLICT if the session is already closed or expired.

external_session_key.description: Optional external session identifier to close; when omitted, closes the implicit current session for the API key.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded in the session_closed event payload.

tool_schemas.name: reactivate_session
tool_schemas.description: Reactivates a previously cleared session by transitioning status from 'cleared' to 'active'. Does not restore purged thoughts; it only allows new thoughts to be appended. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no session/auth context is available, NOT_FOUND if the session cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT if the session is expired or closed.

external_session_key.description: Optional external session identifier to reactivate; when omitted, reactivates the implicit session for the API key if it is in cleared state.

tool_schemas.name: get_session_events
tool_schemas.description: Lists session events for the current session (e.g., session_created, think_appended, thoughts_cleared, session_closed) ordered by created time, returning a page of results with an opaque next cursor. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no session/auth context is available and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination parameters or cursor.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: revoke_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Revokes the currently authenticated API key by transitioning its status from 'active' to 'revoked'. After revocation, all requests using that key are refused. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if no API key is presented and CONFLICT if the key is already revoked.

reason.description: Optional reason recorded for the revocation (stored with the key metadata/audit log where supported).

metadata.name: Think Tool Server
metadata.description: This backend stores per-session thought logs for a "think tool" service. The main workflow is: a client creates/uses a session (implicit via auth/connection), appends thought entries, can list them, clear them (soft-delete via purge), and query session-level statistics. Repository: https://github.co
